messages:
maya (support): paloma labs just reported a big p99 spike during the 02:00-03:00 UTC window, customers seeing timeouts and UX errors. ticket: PAL-4821 :exclamation:
ryan (csm): saw their dashboard — however their request rate didn't change much. they did run a bulk-embed job around 02:05.
maya (support): their error rate jumps right after that job. p95/p99 both up. can eng confirm noisy-tenant pattern? @lina @sam
lina (eng-sre): pulling metrics now. prelim look: one tenant shard (tenant=paloma-7264) consumed a lot of long-running streaming generation requests. binder shows interleaving with other tenants on the same GPU pool.
ops-bot: deploy check OK — no runtime deploys in the window. autoscaler events: spike at 02:07, scaled +1 node at 02:12.
sam (eng-oncall): can you paste the p95/p99 numbers?
lina (eng-sre): paste: ```
baseline (last 7d): p50 110ms, p95 480ms, p99 900ms
02:00-03:00: p50 130ms, p95 1.3s, p99 3.8s
top offender: tenant paloma-7264 - median req length higher + many streaming tokens
```
maya (support): customer complained about timeouts in their app; they rate-limit locally but still saw failed calls. they want an allowance while we mitigate.
ryan (csm): they asked for a short-term soft-reserve + allowlist for priority lane during their business hours. 
lina (eng-sre): short-term plan: 1) apply per-tenant soft throttle (50 rps) on the noisy tenant to smooth tail 2) move paloma-7264 to a reserved slot (ephemeral) on this pool for 30m 3) enable prefix KV caching for their long prompts to reduce token work.
sam (eng-oncall): my worry: moving them could push another tenant into the noisy slot. we should do a canary with reservation on a spare GPU instead of reshuffle.
lina (eng-sre): agreed. I've queued a reservation on spare-node-17 and set tenant throttles. also added a temporary routing rule: route paloma-7264 to reserved slot when traffic > 200 concurrent.
maya (support): I told paloma we have an action plan and ETA ~15m. they agreed to backoff client retries and to pause bulk jobs if we ask.
ryan (csm): they sent logs showing request ids: `req: 6f8d2a4b` failing with 504. sharing with eng.
lina (eng-sre): repro steps collected: reproduce bulk embed job with streaming attached (len=4096 tokens) => causes long KV cache churn. mitigation proved in test: reservation + throttle drops p99 to ~1.0s.
sam (eng-oncall): applied the throttle rule and reservation. monitoring now.
ops-bot: alert suppression enabled for PAL-4821 for 30m.
(later) lina (eng-sre): 20m after mitigation: p95 down to 520ms, p99 ~1.1s. tail still above baseline but tolerable.
maya (support): paloma confirms errors stopped after we paused their bulk job and we routed them to reserved slot. customer thanks and wants a postmortem.
ryan (csm): scheduling follow-up with customer next week to discuss long-term options: Dedicated reservation or per-tenant shaping and quotas.
lina (eng-sre): long-term work items created: 1) per-tenant scheduler isolation (RFC-iss-905) 2) smarter admission control for bulk embed jobs 3) SDK backoff recommendations doc update.
sam (eng-oncall): closing temp reservation in 40m, will watch 24h for regressions.
maya (support): marking ticket PAL-4821 as 'monitoring' and will update after 24h. :white_check_mark:
